item.title: Emulating old junk from yesteryear – or my obsession making native resolution PS2 emulation look good – Maister's Graphics Adventures
item.description: Lately I’ve been on a kick to tackle the latter part of PS2 graphics emulation that never seems to come up, analog TV emulation. 99% of the PS2 emulation space is all about upscaling to the max, cranking out 4K with polygons so sharp they can cleave mountains in half, but that’s not particularly to my taste, which is why paraLLEl-GS focuses more on the super-sampling aspects rather than raw upscaling. Earlier blog post on the paraLLEl-GS here if you have no idea what I’m referring to.

item.title: Suits Are Better Tech Than Modern Clothes
item.description: – Today’s wikipedia picture of the day. That bird looks classy. Violet-backed starling by Charles J. Sharp, CC BY-SA 4.0 Every now and then I have to wear suit and ties. When I first started doing so I hated it. The suits didn’t fit me, the shirts made me feel claustrophobic, the shoes hurt my feet, etc. Then as time passed, naturally I bought more traditional/formal clothing out of necessity, and as I bought the clothes I had them adjusted for me. That made a vast improvement for my comfort.
